frequency_question: How often do sovereign executive principals execute formal renewals or successor agreements for expiring water-sharing treaties within the designated final years of the existing treaty?
membership_rule: Includes binding bilateral water-sharing treaties, basin management pacts, and joint river commission extension accords between neighbouring countries. Excludes non-binding declarations, internal domestic water compacts, and trade agreements.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and subsidiary extensions
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase modifications/extensions
Mexico-United States 1944 Water Treaty minute extensions (e.g., Minute 319 and 323)
Senegal River Basin development organization convention renewals

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named prominent international water resource treaty renewals; comprehensive global count of minor bilateral stream accords is estimated at roughly 12 to 15 major milestones.
known_gaps: Does not account for prolonged stalled negotiations where treaties lapsed entirely without replacement before eventual revival.
validity_reason: State practice regarding vital transboundary water resource renewals remains structurally consistent over multi-decade horizons unless severe regional conflict erupts.
